description: A shell script for testing git status ignored modes, including setup of gitignore, and various tests for git status behavior with ignored, tracked, untracked files, and different options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files for test validation.
